title: Natalee Holloway: The 2005 Aruba Mystery Still Unsolved

scenes.text: American teen vanished on Aruba’s famed Eagle Beach
She was last seen leaving a bar with three men on May 27, 2005
Police recovered a hotel keycard and a blood‑stained shirt, but no body
scenes.query: hotel keycard on desk, forensic tape

scenes.text: The case remains open; no suspect has ever been charged
